comments.author: Destry1
comments.body:
This recipe is correct, but the location is not :)
This recipe is available from the Local Woman in the main square of Marseille.

Recipe: Sewing Bonnet style Hats
Description: Method for making bonnet style hoods for women that leave bangs and brow uncovered.
Product: French Hood (female only)
Durability 50
Formality 10
Defence Power 2
Fabric trading +1
Required Total Fame 5000

Available in red, green and purple
